page.layout: One page: a book cover with a paper label in the centre and a red wax seal below it. No printed text block. Handwriting at the top left and a printed label are not transcribed.
page.notes: The scan shows the outside cover of a book, not a printed page. The printed label reads "Sammlung deutscher Drucke 1450 bis 1912" and "Erworben mit Mitteln der Volkswagen-Stiftung", with a faint embossed emblem between them. The handwritten shelf mark at the top left ("Dogm. 1241 a") and the pencilled marks at the left edge are handwriting and are left out. The red wax seal and the metal clasp at the bottom are not text.
